test_prompts.name: generate-test-plan
test_prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive QA Test Strategy and Test Plan using specs/requirements.md and save it to specs/test-plan.md.
test_prompts.expected_output: Comprehensive test plan containing Scope, Out of Scope, Strategy, Test Scenarios with steps and expected results, and categorized suites.
evaluation_criteria: Contains sections for Scope, Strategy, and Scenarios
Scenarios include Case ID, Steps, and Expected Results
